title: Approve localization model and contracts
acceptance: ADR 0001 accepted by an independent maintainer with the three localization contracts approved; open decisions recorded with owners; no implementation merged before approval.

title: Locale negotiation and fallback chain
acceptance: Explicit preference then header then default resolves deterministically; unknown and disabled locales are rejected against the installed allow-list; negative tests cover malformed oversized and CRLF header input.

title: ICU catalogues and pluralization
acceptance: Catalogues load per locale and domain through the loader contract; plural and select messages render correctly; a missing default-locale key fails the build; the request path performs no directory scanning.

title: Content translation groups and stale detection
acceptance: One translation group links per-locale records that keep their own revision chain; editing a source marks dependents stale by revision hash; migrations are additive and reversible by dropping the new tables.

title: Translation workflow and four-eyes review
acceptance: Status transitions are enforced server-side; a reviewer cannot approve their own translation; machine drafts record provider and timestamp and are disclosed; every transition is audited.

title: Locale routing canonical and hreflang
acceptance: The default locale is unprefixed and other locales are path-prefixed; every locale page emits its own canonical and a reciprocal hreflang set with x-default; unknown locale prefixes return 404 without redirect.

title: Localization administration and XLIFF exchange
acceptance: Administrators enable locales and edit message overrides with an audit trail; completeness and stale reports render; XLIFF import validates and previews before applying; exports are deterministic.

title: Per-locale search indexing and normalization
acceptance: Each published locale is indexed separately with language-aware normalization; queries search the requested locale then the documented fallback with disclosure; an unindexed locale never returns silently empty results.

title: Locale negotiation for REST and MCP
acceptance: Read endpoints accept an explicit locale and otherwise negotiate the header; responses disclose resolved locale and fallback with Content-Language; write endpoints reject a missing locale as a validation error.

title: Language pack extension type
acceptance: Language packs install through the existing lifecycle as data only with no entrypoint; manifests declare locale and domains; conflicting keys resolve by declared precedence and uninstall leaves no orphan keys.

title: Pseudo-localization and completeness gate
acceptance: CI renders every default message under pseudo-localization at 40% width expansion; default-locale completeness is enforced at 100%; RTL snapshots and hreflang reciprocity run automatically.
